verdict.rationale: Clerky is a SaaS legal-paperwork platform that stores sensitive company data, so choosing a data-residency region is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions storage regions, residency options, or data-location controls. Audit logging, collaboration, API and MCP docs are about other features and do not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
